issues.description: The T11 OBJECTIVE explicitly requires .refine(Number.isInteger) on elements. Instead integerIdArray uses z.unknown().refine with an Array.isArray check and a hand-written element loop. This satisfies the requested runtime acceptance cases but does not implement the specified schema construction; the approved Design Decision also rejects the shared hand-written loop approach in favor of Zod array validation. This is a bounded implementation-method/spec deviation, not a demonstrated runtime correctness failure.
